purpose: Machine-readable admission contract for external aggregate benchmark priors such as Verging Labs. Prevents aggregate benchmark data from being mistaken for executable x402 procurement evidence.
decision: Use Verging only as a non-ranking aggregate baseline. James's differentiation test is whether fresh execution-time x402 evidence changes provider choice or retry-adjusted effective cost relative to that prior. If no material decision delta is observed after a comparable paid cohort exists, apply the existing kill criterion rather than broaden the venture.
